description.value: West Point Cycles' West 10th location is British Columbia's oldest bicycle retailer, having opened on this same avenue in 1930. Still family-owned and operated, it carries a broad range of bikes (including e-bikes), parts, and accessories, and is noted as the birthplace of Rocky Mountain Bicycles. Touring cyclists will find a full-service repair department staffed by knowledgeable mechanics alongside a well-stocked shop floor.
